### O18 — `issue(arena, region, destination)`

**Préconditions statiques**

1. L'entrée `arena` existe et est vivante ; `internal` est active. La valeur arène peut être légalement administrée (`MetaRight`).
2. `region` appartient au stockage administré ; `destination` est une **feuille** utilisable, non `Init` (elle peut notamment être `Uninit` ou `Moved`), ne détenant aucune autorité active ; la destination peut légalement recevoir la valeur du bloc au mode `Modify`.
3. Les restrictions **statiques** de validité et de non-échappement applicables à la destination sont satisfaites. Le contrôle de `AnchorOrder` qui dépend de la nouvelle ancre est effectué sur **l’état d’arrivée simulé**, après la vérification de disponibilité décrite au point 4 ; il ne peut transformer une émission indisponible (`fail`) en `reject`.

**Contrôle de disponibilité et d'exercice**

4. Si les conditions statiques tiennent mais que `region` n'appartient plus à `available`, l'opération produit **`fail` et laisse tout l'état inchangé**. Une région indisponible n'autorise pas à contourner un rejet statique préalable.
5. Si la région est disponible, le mode effectif de `internal` sur cette région doit permettre `Modify` ; à défaut, l'issue est `reject` (`noRight`). La région ne peut chevaucher une région émise encore active.
6. Le résultat simulé doit respecter `AnchorOrderHeld` **dans l'état d'arrivée** ; une émission vers une valeur plus durable qu'une ancre locale ne devient pas valide du seul fait qu'elle est stockée chez l'appelant.

**Effet `ok`** : une autorité de bloc d'identité fraîche, dérivée de `internal` et de mode `Modify`, est émise pour la région ; elle est détenue par `destination`, qui reçoit l'ancre correspondante. La région quitte `available` et est ajoutée à `issued` avec son autorité. **Seule la feuille `destination` passe à `Init`** ; aucune autre feuille de la valeur arène ne change d'initialisation. Les émissions antérieures restent intactes et valides. Une émission n'installe pas automatiquement des ancres sur des valeurs tierces : celles-ci doivent utiliser leurs mécanismes légaux de dépendance.

**Issues :** `ok`, `fail` (région indisponible après validation statique), `reject` (règle statique, droit effectif ou ancrage non respecté). La destination peut être une feuille de la valeur arène elle-même : son initialisation constitue alors **l'écriture explicite de cette destination**, et non une initialisation implicite des métadonnées de toute la valeur arène.

### O19 — `reset(arena)`

**Préconditions**

1. L’entrée existe et est vivante. La mise à jour des métadonnées de l’arène est autorisée par **`MetaRight(s,arena)`** : `Modify` exerçable sur la valeur arène **ou** mutation `writeShared` légale sur ses métadonnées `SharedMutable`. L’autorité `internal` et les autres restrictions de l’arène restent valides.
2. Aucune autorité dérivée de `internal` ne reste active : aucune émission vivante ni dérivée subsistante ne peut être invalidée par ce `reset`.
3. Aucun emplacement encore utilisable ne dépend, directement ou transitivement, d'une ancre située dans le sous-arbre d'origines de `internal`. Les obligations de validité d'autres arènes imbriquées restent satisfaites.

**Effet `ok`** : la totalité des régions du stockage administré redevient disponible et la liste des émissions est vidée, sous le contrat de l'arène. Les anciennes autorités émises ne peuvent plus être utilisées, car les préconditions excluaient leur activité. **Aucune feuille n'est rendue `Init` par `reset`**, y compris dans la valeur arène. **Autre issue :** `reject`.

La réutilisation sûre après `reset` exige que les anciennes émissions et leurs dépendants actifs aient effectivement cessé d'exister. Une région historiquement émise ne reste pas définitivement indisponible pour cette seule raison.

## 7. Valeurs non échappantes, transferts et retours de fonctions

La seconde classe des autorités d'accès n'interdit pas de construire une valeur portant une autorité dérivée, ni de restituer un résultat dépendant d'une ressource appartenant à l'appelant. Ce qui est interdit est de prolonger artificiellement la validité d'une origine locale.

Un scénario typique est :

```text
arena = create_arena()
buffer = create_buffer(arena)
use(buffer)
endUse(buffer)       // ou libération équivalente de ses droits dépendants
arena.reset()
```

Le scénario est admissible lorsque :

1. l'appel reçoit et exerce des autorités valides sur l'arène ;
2. une émission fournit un bloc disjoint des émissions vivantes ;
3. la valeur résultat est ancrée sur les droits réellement nécessaires ;
4. son transfert vers l'appelant respecte `SameShape`, les détenteurs, `AnchorOrder` et `AnchorOrderHeld` ;
5. `exitFrame` peut ré-ancrer les autorités survivantes sans utiliser une racine locale morte ;
6. `reset` est refusé tant que le résultat dépendant ou une autorité de bloc reste active, puis redevient admissible après la fin effective de ces droits.

Une valeur « non échappante » n'est donc pas nécessairement limitée à son cadre de création. Elle peut survivre à une fonction lorsqu'elle dépend d'une ancre de l'appelant, sans qu'un stockage local mort soit prolongé. Ce résultat n'implique **pas** la protection forte de toutes les autorités d'un paramètre durant toute l'invocation : l'interprétation historique des ré-emprunts et cette propriété sont différées à la Spec 3.

Les propriétés de transfert entre threads et de partageabilité ne se déduisent pas du seul présent modèle séquentiel. Elles dépendront des ressources externes, des autorités contenues, des ancres, des restrictions de confinement et du modèle de concurrence de la Spec 2.

## 8. Contrats `K` et obligations de sûreté

Un contrat `K` paramètre des règles de MM-03 sans fabriquer de permissions. Une abstraction sûre utilisant une partie de `K` doit prouver ou satisfaire l'obligation correspondante ; des préconditions ignorées dans une exploration Lean ne constituent pas des garanties du langage.

| Contrat | Obligation externe | Statut pour la formalisation du jalon 1 |
|---|---|---|
| `DeclaredDisjoint` | `DDSound(K)` : aucune région déclarée disjointe de façon fausse alors que des feuilles peuvent se chevaucher | Hypothèse nécessaire à la préservation globale d'I1, notamment pour `split` |
| `Pinned` | I5, interdiction des déplacements physiques incompatibles ; `StaticPinnedBottom` pour les statiques épinglés | Obligation spécialisée ; preuves conditionnées à sa satisfaction |
| `SharedMutable` | Discipline de mutation partagée applicable, avec droits et synchronisations corrects | Le noyau ne prouve ni la stabilité de la valeur observée ni l'absence de data race |
| `ExternalDone` | Le recours externe au stockage est terminé lorsque `unpin` est autorisé | Obligation non vérifiée par le noyau pour les dispositifs externes |
| `Deallocable` | L'emplacement appartient à une unité effectivement libérable | Raccordement à MM-02 au jalon 2 |
| `FreeCompat` | L'autorité opaque de désallocation est compatible avec l'unité libérée | Raccordement à MM-02 au jalon 2 |
| `Satisfiable` | Le fournisseur peut satisfaire la forme demandée **dans l'état courant** | Décide `ok` ou `fail` après validation des préconditions statiques de `alloc` |

`Invalidates` n'est pas un champ de `K` pour le présent noyau : les conditions structurelles de `reset`, de `free` et des dépendances portent directement les obligations d'invalidation pertinentes. La réalisation de `DDSound` à partir de dispositions mémoire réelles fait partie du raffinement de MM-03 vers MM-02.

## 9. Obligations de raffinement vers MM-02

MM-03 définit des emplacements logiques, des autorités, des dépendances et leurs transitions. MM-02 définit les allocations, les octets, les emplacements et les opérations mémoire au niveau concret de son propre modèle. **Le jalon 1 n'est pas une preuve de l'implémentation mémoire concrète** : le jalon 2 doit construire une relation de représentation justifiée entre les deux modèles.

### 9.1 — Correspondances exigées

1. **Emplacements et octets :** associer `P`, les feuilles de `footprint`, leur possession et leurs parties aux unités de stockage, offsets, plages, identités et contraintes d'alignement de MM-02 ; établir une disjonction réelle pour les déclarations `DeclaredDisjoint`.
2. **Autorités et opérations :** rattacher les modes effectifs et `ExercisableAt` aux conditions concrètes de lecture, écriture et validité des pointeurs ; montrer qu'un accès sûr MM-03 satisfait les obligations MM-02, sans confondre possession et représentation binaire.
3. **Initialisation :** relier `Uninit`, `Init` et `Moved` aux valeurs et représentations concrètes ; un `store` d'autorité doit correspondre à l'écriture d'une référence réelle dans **une seule feuille logique** sous une représentation adaptée.
4. **Allocation et désallocation :** relier `alloc` / `free` à `AllocStep` / `DeallocStep`, justifier `Satisfiable`, `Deallocable` et `FreeCompat` ainsi que le cas de taille physique nulle.
5. **Durées de vie :** relier `endUse`, `exitFrame`, `NoDangling`, les dépendances et les marques de mort aux effets de validité des stockages réels.
6. **Épinglage et stockage statique :** prouver la compatibilité des déplacements autorisés et des restrictions d'adresses épinglées ; préciser les obligations physiques des statiques et de l'usage externe. La sémantique matérielle spécifique MMIO reste extérieure au noyau séquentiel.
7. **Arènes :** relier les entrées d'arènes, les régions, les émissions, le stockage local/statique/alloué et les métadonnées à des opérations MM-02 ; garantir qu'aucune émission ne réintroduit un accès après invalidation.
8. **`noalias` :** ne conclure aucune propriété de lowering des pointeurs à partir des seuls invariants abstraits ; la justification mémoire se fait ici et les choix de traduction au niveau de la Spec 13.

### 9.2 — Obligations R1–R6

- **R1 — Lecture :** toute lecture sûre autorisée de MM-03 satisfait les préconditions de lecture MM-02.
- **R2 — Écriture :** toute écriture sûre autorisée de MM-03 satisfait les préconditions d'écriture MM-02.
- **R3 — Préservation :** les transitions sûres préservent les invariants du modèle d'accès ; le côté MM-03 est établi dans le jalon 1 sous ses hypothèses déclarées.
- **R4 — Invalidation :** aucun accès encore utilisable ne désigne un stockage invalidé ; le côté MM-03 est étayé par `NoDangling`, mais la correspondance concrète reste à démontrer.
- **R5 — Conservation :** aucune transition sûre ne duplique un droit exclusif incompatible ; le côté MM-03 est établi par les invariants et les résultats de transfert sous leurs hypothèses.
- **R6 — Raffinement :** chaque effet concret attribué à une transition sûre correspond à une transition autorisée de MM-02.

Les obligations R1, R2, le reste de R4 et R6 n'ont **pas** été closes par le jalon 1. La reconstruction de référence pourra utiliser la formalisation exploratoire, mais elle ne peut pas remplacer le texte normatif par des hypothèses ajoutées dans Lean.

## 10. Garanties et limites formelles du jalon 1

Cette section décrit la portée vérifiée de l'exploration Lean ; les noms exacts des théorèmes et leur classement détaillé figurent dans l'**annexe non normative A**. L'exploration est rapportée comme ayant construit, sans avertissement, 607 théorèmes et 362 exemples, sans `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` ni `noncomputable` dans `formal/`, et avec `#print axioms` ne faisant apparaître au plus que `propext` et `Quot.sound`. Il s'agit de résultats **déclarés dans le rapport de passe 8**, non d'un audit indépendant du module source.

La propriété centrale est la préservation de `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan ∧ ArenaInv` sur tous les états atteints depuis `S3.init statics`, **sous `DDSound(K)`**. Des contre-exemples confirment que la même conclusion serait fausse si l'on supprimait certaines hypothèses structurelles ou le contrat de disjonction.

Les preuves portent sur les **accès du noyau abstrait séquentiel**. Elles n'établissent ni l'absence générale de fuites et de blocages, ni la terminaison, ni les propriétés de la concurrence, ni la correction du compilateur ou de la traduction mémoire MM-02. Les garanties différées ne sont pas promises par la présente section.

## 11. Cas d'épreuve et matériel non normatif

Les cas d'épreuve constituent des témoins de validation d'un modèle ; ils ne donnent pas, par leur seule présence, autorité à des règles qui contrediraient les sections 1–9. Les cas en annexe B reprennent des verdicts effectivement décrits dans les rapports Lean. Les corpus adversariaux complets MM2-H, MM3-H et MM23-H sont **réservés au jalon 3**, sans présumer de verdicts encore absents des sources disponibles.

## 12. Hors périmètre, décisions différées et critères de validation

Cette section ne fixe pas la syntaxe des autorités ou des valeurs non échappantes, les annotations de signatures, la généricité, la suspension asynchrone, les destructeurs, les règles complètes de `defer`, la libération automatique de toutes les ressources, le protocole des handles persistants, les graphes à résolution contrôlée, la politique complète des globales mutables, la sémantique concurrente ni le lowering final des accès bruts.

| Sujet différé | Destination retenue |
|---|---|
| Raffinement MM-03 → MM-02 (R1, R2, R4, R6), `DDSound` réel, adresses, allocation, désallocation, provenance, épinglage, initialisation, `store` de pointeur, arènes, justification mémoire de `noalias` | **Jalon 2 de la Spec 1** |
| `NoLock` : autorités détenues inexerçables, cycles de détenteurs, auto-blocage ; handles, pool de handles et expressivité des graphes | **Jalon 3 de la Spec 1** |
| Corpus adversariaux complets MM2-H, MM3-H, MM23-H | **Jalon 3 de la Spec 1** ; cas concurrents dépendants à rouvrir après la Spec 2 |

La candidate v0.3 doit être **contre-analysée opération par opération** contre les préconditions et effets du modèle Lean exploratoire de passe 8, avec une attention spécifique aux écarts ou omissions listés dans l'annexe C. L'accord sur les exemples ne remplace pas la comparaison des définitions. La clôture du jalon 1 ne vaut pas gel de la Spec 1 complète ; MM-01, MM-02 et MM-03 seront assemblés en **un document normatif Memory Model** seulement après validation des jalons pertinents.

## C.2 — Écarts de formulation signalés pour la contre-analyse

Les éléments suivants ne rouvrent pas le jalon 1 et n'autorisent aucune correction implicite du modèle. Ils identifient les points où **la compilation des arbitrages** ou la prose française risque de ne pas décrire exactement la définition appliquée dans le module Lean de passe 8 :

1. **A3 — lecture confirmée.** Un paramètre est une autorité active dérivée **détenue** par l'appelant, puis **cédée** à l'appelé. L'appelant ne la récupère pas automatiquement à la sortie ; le ré-emprunt ordinaire passe par une dérivée fraîche. L'exigence `derivedIn = appelant` reste différée à la Spec 3.
2. **`MetaRight` — disjonction confirmée.** Le droit d'administration des arènes est `Modify` exerçable sur la valeur arène **ou** mutation valide sous `writeShared` des métadonnées `SharedMutable` ; cette lecture est conforme à l'arbitrage C6 et à l'exploration Lean depuis la passe 4.
3. **`WF3` — distinction normative clarifiée.** Les contraintes de bonne fondation des chaînes sont normatives ; les contraintes de croissance ou d'ordre numérique des identifiants sont des choix de représentation Lean. L'éventuelle présence d'une propriété supplémentaire substantielle dans le module devra être signalée et motivée, non recopiée automatiquement.
4. **Contrôles d'arrivée et `fail`.** Pour `issue`, les contrôles `AnchorOrder` et `AnchorOrderHeld` dépendant de l'état d'arrivée ne sont effectués **qu'après** l'évaluation du `fail` pour région indisponible. Les préconditions statiques sans dépendance à l'état d'arrivée restent préalables. Cette priorité ne peut être inversée.
5. **Ré-ancrage de `exitFrame` — formulation confirmée.** La première origine active survivante est conservée, même si elle est détenue par un emplacement ; chercher uniquement une origine détenue par un cadre pourrait rompre I1.
6. **Portée non étendue des préconditions.** `newArena` et `reset` conservent les règles consolidées, avec `MetaRight` explicitement cité pour `reset`. Aucune condition supplémentaire de progrès ou de disjonction globale entre arènes n'est introduite.
7. **Écriture d'une valeur et sémantique physique.** `kind` reste non interprété par l'exploration ; `SameShape` est l'isomorphisme ordonné de l'arbre, **pas** une preuve de type, d'alignement, de layout ou d'ABI identiques. La future spécification de types et le raffinement MM-02 devront établir leurs propres obligations. L'initialisation concrète n'est pas déduite d'un simple drapeau logique `Init`.

## C.3 — Règles remplacées et non reconduites

Ne sont **pas** reconduits dans la v0.3 : la composante `M` autonome, un détenteur exclusivement « cadre », I1 défini uniquement sur les modes effectifs, la lecture des dépendances comme de simples noms, la disjonction globale des arènes, l'initialisation de toute une structure par `store` ou `issue`, le passage de toutes les autorités transférées à la racine de destination, la mise à `Init` implicite des métadonnées par `reset`, la possibilité de libérer une autorité racine par `release`, les contrats `K.Invalidates`, et les projets `NoLock` ou F6 forte présentés comme des garanties déjà adoptées.

Le registre d'arbitrages A–J reste une **source de traçabilité externe** ; ces identifiants ne sont pas nécessaires au texte normatif final, et aucune ancienne variante contradictoire ne doit subsister après la contre-analyse. La candidate v0.3 ne modifie pas le modèle MM-02 et n'engage pas le jalon 2 avant validation éditoriale.

abbrev KF45 : K := KT [] [] [] [4, 5] [(4, 7), (5, 7)]
def h17d : PS := run KF45 [] (h17p ++ [.issue 0 0 [5] 2])

/-- **H17** (C; A6, `Deallocable`; Lib; covered pass 2). `free` of the block on `[5]`: rejected,
the region is a part of the storage, not an owned root, nor deallocable under `KF4`; with the region
declared deallocable (`KF45`), the `free` is still rejected (`OwnedRoot`). Expected: reject;
obtained: reject. Twin: in the same run, the block ended, the `free` of the allocated storage 4 is
accepted. -/
theorem H17 : PReach KF4 [] h17 ∧ FreeStep KF4 5 7 h17.s .reject ∧
    PReach KF45 [] h17d ∧ ¬ OwnedRoot h17d.s 5 ∧ FreeStep KF45 5 7 h17d.s .reject ∧
    PReach KF4 [] h17t ∧ FreeStep KF4 4 7 h17t.s (.ok (freeEff h17t.s 4)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    by decide, .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-! ## D. Arenas -/

/-- H18: the arena of H17 under `K0`, the block on `[5]` issued to 2. -/
def h18 : PS := run K0 [] (h17p ++ [.issue 0 0 [5] 2])

/-- **H18** (D; A5; Lib). The arena value transferred into a block of its own storage: rejected,
the storage would be owned by one of its parts. Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin: the
transfer of the arena value into the local leaf 3 is accepted. -/
theorem H18 : PReach K0 [] h18 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 5 h18.s .reject ∧
    ¬ (transferEff h18.s 0 5).Usable 5 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 h18.s (.ok (transferEff h18.s 0 3)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H19: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, values 2 and 3; storage 4 with the leaf 5; parent
arena on 4; block 5 on `[5]` issued to 2; child arena on the leaf 5 with `internal` the block 5. -/
def h19p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1], .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 4, none, 0)],
  .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4, .issue 0 0 [5] 2, .newArena 5 5]
def h19 : PS := run K0 [] h19p

/-- **H19** (D; F1; Lib; covered pass 6). `reset` of the parent while the child lives: rejected;
after `endUse` of the child value 2: accepted. Expected: reject, then `ok`; obtained: the same. -/
theorem H19 : PReach K0 [] h19 ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 h19.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h19p ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- **H20** (D; A10, `arena_reuse_safe`; Lib). `alloc`, `newArena`, `issue`, `endUse`, `reset`, then
`issue` of the same region: every step `ok`. Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H20 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
    .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 3, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .newArena 3 3, .issue 0 0 [4] 2, .endUse 2,
    .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [4] 2]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- **H21** (D; case 16; Lib; covered pass 5). The arena of case 16, with a `SharedMutable` arena
value 0 (`KA`): frame 1 passes 4, `Observe` on the arena value, and 5, `Modify` on its buffer 2;
the callee issues `[4]` to its local 6 through `writeShared` on the metadata, transfers 6 to 2 and
exits. Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok` at each step. -/
theorem H21 : PReach KA [] (run KA [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
    .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 3, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .newArena 3 3,
    .derive 0 0 .observe, .derive 2 2 .modify, .enter [4, 5] [lf], .issue 0 4 [4] 6,
    .transfer 6 2, .exit]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H21b: frame 1, result 0, derives 1, `Modify` on it, and calls frame 2 with the arena value 1 and
the local buffer 2 with the parts 3 and 4; the callee derives 4, `Modify` on the buffer, stores it
into the arena value, and creates the arena. -/
def h21b : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .derive 0 0 .modify,
  .enter [1] [lf, lf, (some 2, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0)], .derive 3 2 .modify, .store 4 1,
  .newArena 2 4]

/-- **H21b** (D; F2, G4; Lib; covered passes 6 and 7). An arena on a local buffer, transferred to
the caller: rejected at the `transfer` by `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state (G4). Expected:
reject; obtained: reject. Twin: H37, the arena on an allocated storage owned by its value. -/
theorem H21b : PReach K0 [] h21b ∧ TransferStep K0 1 0 h21b.s .reject ∧
    ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff h21b.s 1 0) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), by decide⟩

/-! ## E. Pinning and static storage -/

/-- H22: frame 1, `x` (0) written and pinned, `y` (1). -/
def h22 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .pin 0]
def h22t : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0]]

/-- **H22** (E; A8; N3; covered pass 2). The transfer of a value whose in-place leaf is pinned is
rejected; the transfer of a value whose owned storage only is pinned is accepted. Expected:
reject / `ok`; obtained: the same. Twin of the rejection: without the pin, accepted. -/
theorem H22 : PReach K0 [] h22 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 1 h22.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h22t ∧
    TransferStep K0 0 1 h22t.s (.ok (transferEff h22t.s 0 1)) ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf],
      .pin 3, .transfer 1 2]) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- H23: frame 1 calls frame 2 with the local 1, pinned. -/
def h23 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .enter [] [lf], .pin 1]

/-- **H23** (E; B4; N3; covered pass 3). Exit of a frame whose local is pinned: rejected. Expected:
reject; obtained: reject. Twin without the pin: accepted. -/
theorem H23 : PReach K0 [] h23 ∧ ExitStep K0 h23.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .enter [] [lf], .exit]) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- Statics: the MMIO leaf 0, `Init`, and the leaf 1. -/
def stM : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false)]
/-- Contracts with the static leaf 0 pinned. -/
abbrev KM : K := KT [] [0] [] [] []

def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `a` is released by the end of the value at `p` (A4, A6): it is active, and held
within `p` (released by `endUseS`) or by a holder that is not live after `endUseS` (released by
`cleanup`). Under the possession clause of `WF3`, that holder dies with `p`. -/
def EndUseReleased (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧
    (heldIn s.P p z.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) z.holder)) False

instance (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseReleased s p a) := by
  unfold EndUseReleased; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block the end of the value at `p` (A6): if it is an active derived
authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end releases
(MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    ((∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) ∨ ∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, EndUseReleased s p a) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives the end of the value at `p` (A6): not held within `p`, not the root of
`p`, with a holder that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse p` (A6). Usability of the anchored places is read after the end:
a place that dies with `p` has no usable dependent afterwards. In order: `p` usable;
exercisable `Modify` on `p` (A2);
no active derived authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end
releases (MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), held elsewhere than in `p` and staying live; no
usable place anchored on an authority held by `p`, on its root, or held by a holder that dies;
C5: no ending leaf pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`), whatever `ExternalDone`
says: external obligations end only through `unpin`. The ending leaves include those of the
owned places, which die (A6). C8: `p` itself stays usable, its leaves `Uninit`. -/
def EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q,
    EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
    Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) := by
  unfold EndUsePre; infer_instance

/-- `endUse` as a relation (A6). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

theorem endUseS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (endUseS s p) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [endUseS], fun j z hz => ?_⟩
  simp only [endUseS, List.getElem?_map] at hz
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz; cases hz
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hz; subst hz
    refine ⟨y, rfl, ?_⟩; split <;> simp_all

theorem endUseS_get (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : (endUseS s p).A[j]? =
    (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y := by
  simp [endUseS]

/-- Under `EndUsePre` (A6), every anchor of a place usable after the end stays active. -/
theorem endUse_anchors {k : K} {s : S3} {p : Nat} (hinv : Inv3base s) (hpre : EndUsePre k s p) :
    ∀ q, (endUseS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, (cleanup (endUseS s p)).Active x := by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hanc, -⟩ := hpre
  intro q hq x hx
  have hq₀ : s.Usable q := S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseS s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hq
  have hx₀ : x ∈ s.D q := by
    simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · exact hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hinv.2.2.1 q hq₀ x hx₀
  have hc := hanc q (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq x hx
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP at hc
  rw [hy] at hc; obtain ⟨hnh, -, hl⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨_, by rw [cleanup_get, endUseS_get, hy]; rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [hnh, ↓reduceIte]
  have : HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder := hl
  simp only [this, ↓reduceIte, ya]

/-- `endUse` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (A6). -/
theorem endUse_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine releases_preserve hwf hinv (endUseS_releases s p) rfl rfl rfl ?_ (endUse_anchors hinv hpre)
  intro q pl r hq hp
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, -, ho, hd⟩ := hwf.parts q pl r hq hp
  simp only [endUseS, hq, hpr, ho, hd]

/-- `endUse` preserves `Inv3base` without `WF3` (A1; A6). -/
theorem endUse_preserves_inv3 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact releases_preserve_inv3 hinv (endUseS_releases s p) (endUse_anchors hinv hpre)

/-- `endUse_no_dealloc_event` (A6): `endUse` releases no storage and kills no owned place
physically: `freed` is unchanged. -/
theorem endUse_no_dealloc_event {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) :
    s'.freed = s.freed := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl

/-- `endUse_preserves_dependents` (A6): no usable dependent loses an anchor; a usable place other
than a part of `p` keeps its anchors, all valid. -/
theorem endUse_preserves_dependents {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ¬ partOf s.P q p → s'.D q = s.D q ∧ ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, s'.Active x := by
  have hp := endUse_preserves hwf hinv h
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq hnp
  exact ⟨by simp [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS, hnp], hp.2.2.2.1 q hq⟩

/-! ## `free` (A6) -/

/-- The holder is a place (A4, A5). -/
def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
  | .place _ => true
  | .frame _ => false

/-- The place `p` is an owned root (A6, owned place): no parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance

/-- Storage at `p` released (A6), before releasing authorities whose holder died: `p` and its
parts are dead, `p` is freed, every authority covering a leaf of `p` or held within `p` is
released, the anchors of `p` and its parts are removed. -/
def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (partOf s.P q p)
    freed := fun q => s.freed q || decide (q = p)
    A := s.A.map fun y => if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
      { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `free p auth` (A6): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
released. -/
def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)

/-- Leaves whose storage ends with the release of `p` (A6): those of `p`, and those of places
that stop being usable, such as the places owned by `p`. -/
def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)

instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `a` is released by the release of `p` (A4, A6): it is active, and covers a leaf of
`p` or is held within `p` (released by `freeS`), or its holder is not live after `freeS`
(released by `cleanup`). Under the possession clause of `WF3`, that holder dies with `p`. -/
def FreeDeact (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧ ((∃ l ∈ z.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨
    heldIn s.P p z.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) z.holder)) False

instance (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Decidable (FreeDeact s p a) := by
  unfold FreeDeact; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block the release of `p` (A6): if it is an active derived authority on
a freed leaf, or descending from an authority that the release releases (MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), it
is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    ((∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) ∨ ∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, FreeDeact s p a) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives the release of `p` (A6): it covers no leaf of `p`, is not held within
`p`, and its holder stays live. -/
def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (A6), in order: `p` deallocable by the allocator contract
(`Deallocable`) and `auth` a compatible deallocation authority (`FreeCompat`, MM-03.3.8); `p` a
usable owned root (a part is not a unit of storage, and `WF3` gives a part the `dead` flag of its
parent); exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2); no active derived authority on a freed leaf, or
descending from a deactivated authority, held elsewhere and staying live; no usable place
anchored on an authority covering `p`, held within `p`, or whose holder dies; no freed leaf
pinned, statically (`Pinned`) or dynamically, without exception (B6: external obligations end
only through `unpin` under `ExternalDone`). -/
def FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop :=
  k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧ s.Usable p ∧ OwnedRoot s p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (freeS s p).D q,
    FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned]
    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) := by
  unfold FreePre; infer_instance

/-- `free` as a relation (A6). -/
def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)

theorem freeS_get (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : (freeS s p).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
    if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
      { y with active := false } else y := by
  simp [freeS]

theorem freeS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (freeS s p) := by

import Ern.MM03

/-!
# Handle pool (jalon 3, step 1)

A library instance of the access discipline, like the arena (MM-03.3 §6): the handle pool of the
jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §4). A handle is data and carries no authority. A
resolution is a compound borrow made of kernel operations of `Ern.MM03`, which this module does
not modify: a companion derived from `internal` on the whole storage, then one entry authority per
resolved handle, derived from the companion (`derive` for `resolve`, `split` for `resolveMany`).
`unresolve` is a sequence of `release`, `freeSlot` an `endUse` of the entry content, `allocSlot` a
`write3` of the handle into its destination. The pool entries live beside the kernel state, like
the arena entries of MM-03.3.8 but outside `S3`, so the kernel is unchanged.

`PReach` extends `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10) with the pool operations; every pool step is a chain of
kernel steps (`pReach_reachable`). Representation choices that the material does not fix are listed
in the jalon-3 report, (f).
-/

namespace Ern.HandlePool

open Ern.MM03

/-! ## State (material §4) -/

/-- Entry of a pool (material §4: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`): `place` is a part of the
pool storage. -/
structure Slot where
  place : Nat
  gen : Nat
  live : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Pool entry (material §4: `{id, storage, internal, slots}`), abstract like the arena entry of
MM-03.3.8. The pool value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (material §4,
"même règle que F1"). -/
structure Pool where
  id : Nat
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  slots : List Slot
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Handle (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`): data of fixed size, no authority. -/
structure Handle where
  id : Nat
  slot : Nat
  gen : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Ghost record of a resolution (material §4, compound borrow): identity and `internal` of the
pool, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities, each tagged with its slot and the
resolved generation ("étiquetée de la génération résolue"). Read by no operation except
`unresolve`, which looks up the entries of a companion. -/
structure Res where
  pool : Nat
  internal : Nat
  comp : Nat
  mode : Mode
  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Kernel state with the pool entries (material §4), the next fresh pool identity ("jamais
réutilisée pendant l'exécution") and the ghost record of resolutions. -/
structure PS where
  s : S3
  pools : List Pool
  nId : Nat
  res : List Res

/-- Outcomes of a pool operation (material §4: `ok | fail | reject`): `fail` is a defined failure
that leaves the state unchanged, as for `alloc` and `issue` (MM-03.3 §3.1). -/
inductive POutcome where
  | ok (ps : PS)
  | fail (ps : PS)
  | reject

/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse the metadata right
and the arena invariant of MM-03.3 §6 (`MetaRight`, `ArenaInv`). -/
def Pool.asArena (pl : Pool) : Arena := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩

/-- Right to update the pool value (material §4, `allocSlot` and `freeSlot`: "`Modify` exerçable
ou `writeShared` sur métadonnées `SharedMutable`"): the metadata right of the arena (MM-03.3 §6,
`MetaRight`), read on the holder of `internal`. -/
def PoolRight (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) : Prop := MetaRight k s pl.asArena via

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (PoolRight k s pl via) := by
  unfold PoolRight; infer_instance

/-- Place of slot `i` (0 if the slot does not exist). -/
def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0

/-- The pool with its slot `i` replaced. -/
def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }

/-- The extended state with its pool `j` replaced. -/
def setPool (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) : PS := { ps with pools := ps.pools.set j pl }

/-! ## `newPool storage internal` (material §4) -/

/-- Preconditions of `newPool storage internal` (material §4: "préconditions de `newArena` (F1, F2,
J1)"): those of `newArena` (MM-03.3 §6, O17), read literally, so clause 4 speaks of the arenas of
the state. -/
def NewPoolPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop := NewArenaPre s storage internal

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewPoolPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewPoolPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newPool storage internal` (material §4): a pool with a fresh identity, one free
entry of generation 0 per child of the storage (the entries are the parts of `storage`, report (f)),
and the kernel state unchanged. -/
def newPoolEff (ps : PS) (storage internal : Nat) : PS :=
  { ps with
    pools := ps.pools ++ [⟨ps.nId, storage, internal,
      (kids ps.s.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
    nId := ps.nId + 1 }

/-- `newPool storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (material §4). -/
def NewPoolStep (storage internal : Nat) (ps : PS) : Outcome3 PS → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewPoolPre ps.s storage internal) (newPoolEff ps storage internal)

/-! ## `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4) -/

/-- First free entry of a list of slots, counted from `i`. -/
def firstFreeF : Nat → List Slot → Option Nat
  | _, [] => none
  | i, sl :: l => if sl.live then firstFreeF (i + 1) l else some i

/-- First free entry of a pool (report (f): the material does not say which free entry). -/
def firstFree (pl : Pool) : Option Nat := firstFreeF 0 pl.slots

/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4): the right to update the pool value;
`dst` a usable leaf, not `Init`, holding no active authority, under exercisable `Modify`. The size
of a handle is not represented: MM-03 has no sizes (report (f)). -/
def AllocSlotStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  PoolRight k s pl via ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
      True

True

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (AllocSlotStatic k s pl via dst) := by
  unfold AllocSlotStatic; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the entry becomes live,
its content is not changed (the material says it stays `Uninit`, which holds when it was `Uninit`:
report, (g)), the handle is written into `dst`, which alone becomes `Init`. -/
def allocSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PS :=
  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) with s := write3Eff ps.s [dst] }

/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` into its destination (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`). -/
def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩

/-- `allocSlot pool dst : ok | fail | reject` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when a static
precondition fails or the pool does not exist; `fail`, state unchanged, when no entry is free;
`ok` otherwise, on the first free entry. -/
inductive AllocSlotStep (k : K) (j via dst : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl →
      AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst → firstFree pl = some i → pl.slots[i]? = some sl →
      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok (allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst))
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
      firstFree pl = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject

/-! ## `resolve h m` and `resolveMany hs m` (material §4) -/

/-- The handle designates a live entry of the pool, at its generation (material §4, `resolve`:
`fail` "si `h.id` n'est pas l'identité du pool, si `h.gen` diffère de la génération de l'entrée,
ou si l'entrée est libre"). A slot index outside the pool designates no entry (report (f)). -/
def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False

instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance

/-- Right of the pool value to exercise `internal` at mode `m` (material §4, `resolve`): the
precondition of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1) of the companion, from `internal`, on the whole storage.
It reads the effective mode of `internal`, so an active `Modify` companion rejects every new
resolution, whatever the handles (material §4, H31a). -/
def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop := DerivePre s pl.internal pl.storage m

instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance

/-- State after the compound borrow of one entry (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`,
derived from `internal` on the storage, then the entry authority `s.A.length + 1`, derived from the
companion on the place `q` of the entry, both at mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
def resolveS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  deriveEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length q m

/-- `resolve h m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when
the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged, when the handle is stale, of another pool or names
a free entry; `ok` with the compound borrow, recorded with the resolved generation. The derive of
the entry is a kernel step: its precondition is checked (`noEntry`). -/
inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → HandleOK pl h →
      pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
      ResolveStep j h m ps (.ok { ps with
        s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
          [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
      ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      ¬ DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m ps .reject

/-- The handles of a batch all designate live entries of the pool at their generation, and pairwise
distinct entries (material §4, `resolveMany`: `fail` "si un handle est périmé ou d'un autre pool,
ou si deux handles désignent la même entrée"). -/
def BatchOK (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Prop :=
  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK pl h) ∧ (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup

instance (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Decidable (BatchOK pl hs) := by
  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance

/-- Regions of the entries of a batch: the footprint of each designated entry. -/
def batchRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)

/-- State after the compound borrow of a batch (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`, then one
entry authority per handle by `split` of the companion (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
def resolveManyS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  splitEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length (batchRegions s pl hs)

/-- Entry authorities of a batch with their slot and generation: the `i`-th split authority has the
identity `c + 1 + i` for the companion `c`. -/
def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs

/-- `resolveMany hs m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject`
when the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged and no authority created (atomicity), when the
batch is not valid; `ok` with the compound borrow when the `split` of the companion is accepted,
`reject` otherwise (`noSplit`). -/
inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) :
    POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
      SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok { ps with
        s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
          batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] })
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ BatchOK pl hs →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
  | noSplit {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
      ¬ SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject

/-! ## `unresolve` (material §4) -/

/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (MM-03.3 §3, O3); `none` as soon as a release is
rejected. -/
def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
  | s, [] => some s
  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none

/-- The resolution whose companion is `c`. -/
def findRes (ps : PS) (c : Nat) : Option Res := ps.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c

/-- `unresolve` of the resolution of companion `c` as a relation (material §4: "`release` des
autorités d'entrée, puis de la compagne"): `ok` when every release is accepted, `reject`
otherwise or when `c` is no companion. -/
inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes ps c = some r →
      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = some s' →
      UnresolveStep c ps (.ok { ps with s := s' })
  | reject {r : Res} : findRes ps c = some r →
      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject
  | none : findRes ps c = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject

/-! ## `freeSlot h` (material §4) -/

/-- The handle is current for the pool (material §4, `freeSlot`: `fail` "si `h` est périmé ou d'un
autre pool"): same identity, an existing entry of the same generation. -/
def HandleCur (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen) False

instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleCur pl h) := by
  unfold HandleCur; infer_instance

/-- An active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the place `q` of an entry
(material §4, `freeSlot`: `reject` "si une autorité active dérivée de `internal` couvre
l'entrée"). -/
def EntryBorrowed (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j ∧ pl.internal ∈ s.ancs j ∧
    ∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q

instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (EntryBorrowed s pl q) := by
  unfold EntryBorrowed; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the end of the content of
the entry by `endUse` (MM-03.3 §3, O12), then the entry is free and its generation incremented. -/
def freeSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PS :=
  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) with
    s := endUseEff ps.s sl.place }

/-- `freeSlot h : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4), in order:
`reject` without the right to update the pool value; `fail`, state unchanged, for a stale handle
or one of another pool; `reject` when an active authority derived from `internal` covers the
entry; `reject` when a precondition of `endUse` fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive FreeSlotStep (k : K) (j via : Nat) (h : Handle) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl))
  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via → ¬ HandleCur pl h →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.fail ps)
  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | borrowed {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | endUse {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
      ¬ EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject

/-! ## Reachability extended with the pool (material §4, "intégration à `Reachable`") -/

/-- One step of the extended machine: a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10, `Step`) on the kernel
state, or an `ok` pool operation (material §4). -/
inductive PStep (k : K) : PS → PS → Prop where
  | kernel {ps : PS} {s' : S3} : Step k ps.s s' → PStep k ps { ps with s := s' }
  | newPool {ps ps' : PS} {st i : Nat} : NewPoolStep st i ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
  | allocSlot {ps ps' : PS} {j via dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok ps') →
      PStep k ps ps'
  | resolve {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} : ResolveStep j h m ps (.ok ps') →
      PStep k ps ps'
  | resolveMany {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
  | unresolve {ps ps' : PS} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
  | freeSlot {ps ps' : PS} {j via : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok ps') →
      PStep k ps ps'

/-- Initial extended state: `S3.init statics` (MM-03.3.9), no pool, no resolution. -/
def PS.init (statics : Statics) : PS := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩

/-- States reached from the initial state by kernel, arena and pool steps (material §4, extension of
`Reachable`, MM-03.3 §10). -/
inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PS → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → PReach k statics (PS.init statics)
  | step {ps ps' : PS} : PReach k statics ps → PStep k ps ps' → PReach k statics ps'

/-! ## Kernel steps keep authorities and footprints (MM-03.3 §3–6) -/

/-- The authorities of `s` remain in `s'` with their mode and footprint; one active in `s'` was

import Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-!
# Measure of the `NoLock` options (jalon 3, step 4)

The options of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §5), measured on the kernel as it
is (option 1, no rule), without modifying it:

* option 2, a local rule: an operation does not place an authority into a place it covers
  (`SelfLock`); `store` already rejects it (O8.3), so the rule is measured on `transfer` and
  `issue` (`opt2`);
* option 3, `NoLock`: no self-lock, as a separate clause, and the relation "`b` blocks `a`"
  (`Blocks`) acyclic, checked on the arrival state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store` (`opt3`).

For each case of the list "doit être accepté" of §5 (H11, H19, H29b, H35 to H37, H44 to H47, W1
to W3) and for H49 to H51, `decisions` gives the decision of an option on each `transfer`, `issue`
and `store` of the run of the case (`Ern.MM03.Horrors`), decided on the state where the step runs;
`true` is acceptance. The cost, measured as the brief asks (from the authorities and places the
operation touches, or the whole state): option 2 on `transfer` depends on the state only through the
places and the authorities the transfer moves (`opt2_transfer_local`), on `issue` only through the
region and the destination (`opt2_issue_local`); option 3 depends on authorities the operation does
not touch (`opt3_not_local`). Whether option 3 needs more than the function where the operation runs
(material §5, "locale à une fonction") is not settled here (report, (g)). No option is adopted
(material §5: "la décision revient à l'arbitrage").
-/

namespace Ern.MM03.LockOptions

open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool Ern.MM03.Horrors

/-! ## Option 2: self-lock -/

/-- The leaves of a holder (MM-03.3.4): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Self-lock of the authority `a` (material §5, options 2 and 3): `a` is active and held by a place
one of whose leaves it covers. -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Option 2 on `transfer src dst` (material §5): no authority moved by the transfer, one held within
the source, is self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Transfer (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (Opt2Transfer s src dst) := by
  unfold Opt2Transfer; infer_instance

/-- Option 2 on `issue` of `region` to `dst` (material §5): the block, the new authority, is not
self-locked in the arrival state. -/
def Opt2Issue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ¬ SelfLock (issueEff s ar region dst).1 s.A.length

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (Opt2Issue s ar region dst) := by
  unfold Opt2Issue; infer_instance

/-! ## Option 3: `NoLock` -/

/-- "`b` bloque `a`" (material §5, option 3): `b ≠ a`, both active, and the footprint of `b` contains
a leaf of the holder of `a`. -/
def Blocks (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Prop :=
  b ≠ a ∧ s.Active b ∧ s.Active a ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => ∃ l ∈ s.afp b, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (b a : Nat) : Decidable (Blocks s b a) := by unfold Blocks; infer_instance

/-- The authorities blocked by one of `xs`. -/
def blockedBy (s : S3) (xs : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filter fun a => decide (∃ b ∈ xs, Blocks s b a)

/-- The authorities reached from `xs` by at most `n` steps of `Blocks`, `xs` included. -/
def blockReach (s : S3) : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, xs => xs
  | n + 1, xs => blockReach s n (xs ++ blockedBy s xs)

/-- Acyclicity of `Blocks` (material §5, option 3): no authority is reached from itself by one or
more steps. Every step leads to an authority of `A`, so a cycle has at most `A.length` steps and the
search with that bound is complete (report, (f)). -/
def BlocksAcyclic (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∉ blockReach s s.A.length (blockedBy s [a])

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (BlocksAcyclic s) := by unfold BlocksAcyclic; infer_instance

/-- `NoLock` (material §5, option 3): no self-lock (separate clause) and `Blocks` acyclic. -/
def NoLock (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ SelfLock s a) ∧ BlocksAcyclic s

instance (s : S3) : Decidable (NoLock s) := by unfold NoLock; infer_instance

/-! ## Decisions along the runs -/

/-- Option 2 on an operation from the extended state `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule). Only
`transfer` and `issue` are checked; `store` is left to O8.3. -/
def opt2 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
  | .transfer src dst => decide (Opt2Transfer ps.s src dst)
  | .issue i _ region dst =>
    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar => decide (Opt2Issue ps.s ar region dst)
    | none => true
  | _ => true

/-- Option 3 on an operation from `ps` (`true`: accepted by the rule): `NoLock` of the arrival
state of `transfer`, `issue` and `store`. -/
def opt3 (ps : PS) : Op → Bool
  | .transfer src dst => decide (NoLock (transferEff ps.s src dst))
  | .issue i _ region dst =>
    match ps.s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar => decide (NoLock (arenaSet (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).1 i
        (issueEff ps.s ar region dst).2))
    | none => true
  | .store a p => decide (NoLock (storeEff ps.s a p))
  | _ => true

/-- The operations checked by the options: `transfer`, `issue`, `store`. -/
def checked : Op → Bool
  | .transfer .. => true
  | .issue .. => true
  | .store .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The decisions of the option `D` on the checked steps of a run of `K0` from `ps`, each on the
state where the step runs, in order, as long as the steps are `ok` in the kernel. -/
def decisions (D : PS → Op → Bool) (ps : PS) : List Op → List Bool
  | [] => []
  | o :: os =>
    match pexec K0 ps o with
    | some ps' => (if checked o then [D ps o] else []) ++ decisions D ps' os
    | none => []

/-- The run from `S3.init []` of a case. -/
def dec2 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt2 (PS.init []) os
def dec3 (os : List Op) : List Bool := decisions opt3 (PS.init []) os

/-! ## Cases that must be accepted (material §5) -/

/-- The runs of the cases that must be accepted, with their names: each is a run of
`Ern.MM03.Horrors` reached under `K0`, except H21's arena which is not on the list. -/
def mustAccept : List (String × List Op) :=
  [("H11", h11p ++ [.endUse 3, .endUse 6, .reset 0 0]),
   ("H19", h19p ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0]),
   ("H29b", h29bo), ("H35", h35o), ("H36", h36o), ("H37", h37o), ("H44", h44o),
   ("H45", h45o), ("H46", h46o), ("H47", h47o), ("W1", w1o),
   ("W2", w2o ++ [.release 12, .release 11, .release 10, .transfer 9 16, .transfer 12 19]),
   ("W3", w3o ++ [.endUse 5, .endUse 2, .endUse 3, .endUse 4, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 2]),
   ("W3v", w3vo ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [10] 3])]

/-- Every run of the list is `ok` in the kernel at each step, so the decisions cover all its
checked steps. -/
theorem mustAccept_runs : mustAccept.all (fun c => (prun K0 (PS.init []) c.2).isSome) = true := by
  decide

/-- The decisions of option 2 on the checked steps of each case. -/
theorem opt2_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec2 c.2)) =
    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true])] := by
  decide

/-- The decisions of option 3 on the checked steps of each case. -/
theorem opt3_decisions : mustAccept.map (fun c => (c.1, dec3 c.2)) =
    [("H11", [true, true, true]), ("H19", [true]), ("H29b", [true]), ("H35", []),
     ("H36", []), ("H37", [true]), ("H44", [true]), ("H45", [true, true, true, true]),
     ("H46", [true]), ("H47", [true]), ("W1", []), ("W2", [true, true]),
     ("W3", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true]), ("W3v", [true, true, true, true, true, true, true])] := by
  decide

/-- No false rejection (material §5, criterion): neither option rejects a checked step of a case that
must be accepted. -/
theorem no_false_rejection : mustAccept.all (fun c => (dec2 c.2).all id && (dec3 c.2).all id) =
    true := by
  decide

/-! ## Residual blockings (H49 to H51) -/

/-- H49 (the cycle closed through a helper then its `release`): option 2 accepts every checked step,
so the blocking of H49 remains; option 3 rejects the `store` that closes the cycle (the fourth checked
step), the helper notwithstanding. -/
theorem H49_options : dec2 h49o = [true, true, true, true] ∧
    dec3 h49o = [true, true, true, false] := by
  decide

/-- The state and the step of H49 where option 3 rejects: `store 8 6` with the helper 9 active; in
its arrival state, 7 and 8 block each other. -/
theorem H49_cycle : Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 7 8 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])).s 8 6) 8 7 :=
  by decide

/-- H50 (an authority transferred or issued into the place it covers): both options reject the
`transfer` and the `issue`, by the self-lock. -/
theorem H50_options : dec2 h50ao = [true, false] ∧ dec3 h50ao = [true, false] ∧
    dec2 h50bo = [false] ∧ dec3 h50bo = [false] := by
  decide

/-- H51 (an element of a storage owned by `v` holds a view on `v`): option 2 accepts the `store`, and
would even if it checked `store`: the view is not self-locked, the configuration being a cycle of
two authorities, which option 2 does not cover (material §5); the blocking remains. Option 3 rejects
the `store`: in its arrival state, the root of the storage, held by `v`, and the view, held by the
element, block each other. -/
theorem H51_options : dec2 h51o = [true] ∧ dec3 h51o = [false] ∧
    ¬ SelfLock (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 2 4 ∧
    Blocks (storeEff (run K0 [] (h51o.take 6)).s 4 3) 4 2 := by
  decide

/-! ## Cost of the check -/

/-- Locality of option 2 on `transfer`: the decision depends on the state only through the places and
the authorities held within the source, the ones the transfer moves. Two states with the same places
and the same such authorities, at the same identities, get the same decision. -/
theorem opt2_transfer_local {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (s.A[j]? = some y ∨ s'.A[j]? = some y) →
      heldIn s.P src y.holder → s'.A[j]? = s.A[j]?) :
    Opt2Transfer s' src dst ↔ Opt2Transfer s src dst := by
  have key : ∀ (t t' : S3), t'.P = t.P →
      (∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), (t.A[j]? = some y ∨ t'.A[j]? = some y) →
        heldIn t.P src y.holder → t'.A[j]? = t.A[j]?) →
      Opt2Transfer t src dst → Opt2Transfer t' src dst := by
    intro t t' hP hA h j hj hheld hsl
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hheld
    rw [hP] at hh
    have e := hA j y (.inr hy) hh
    have hy' : t.A[j]? = some y := e.symm.trans hy
    refine h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy')) (optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy', hh⟩) ?_
    have ga : (transferEff t' src dst).A[j]? = (transferEff t src dst).A[j]? := by
      rw [transfer_A_get, transfer_A_get, e, hP]
    have gl : holderLeaves (transferEff t' src dst) = holderLeaves (transferEff t src dst) := by
      funext hd
      cases hd with
      | place p => simp only [holderLeaves, transferEff, hP]
      | frame f => rfl
    unfold SelfLock at hsl ⊢
    rw [ga, gl] at hsl
    exact hsl
  refine ⟨key s' s hP.symm (fun j y hy hh => ?_), key s s' hP hA⟩
  rw [hP] at hh
  exact (hA j y hy.symm hh).symm

/-- Option 2 on `issue` reads only the region and the destination: the block is self-locked exactly
when the destination's footprint meets the region. -/
theorem opt2_issue_local (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Opt2Issue s ar region dst ↔ ¬ ∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P dst := by
  unfold Opt2Issue SelfLock
  simp only [issueEff, S3.addAuth, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_refl _), Nat.sub_self,
    List.getElem?_cons_zero, OptP, true_and, holderLeaves]

/-- The states of `opt3_not_local`: the state of H48 with the helper 9 (`Modify` on the node 6,
derived from 7), and the same run without the `store` of 7, which stays held by the frame. -/
def nl1 : PS := run K0 [] (h48o ++ [.derive 7 6 .modify])
def nl2 : PS := run K0 [] (fao ++ [.derive 6 6 .modify, .derive 5 5 .modify, .derive 7 6 .modify])

/-- Option 3 is not local to the operation: in two reached states where the kernel accepts
`store 8 6`, with the same places, the same stored authority 8 and as many authorities, the decisions
differ. The states differ by the authority 7, which the step does not touch (stored into the node 5
in the first, held by the frame in the second), and by the initialisation and anchors of the node 5,
which option 3 does not read. Both states are in one frame (report, (g)). -/
theorem opt3_not_local :
    PReach K0 [] nl1 ∧ PReach K0 [] nl2 ∧
    StoreStep 8 6 nl1.s (.ok (storeEff nl1.s 8 6)) ∧ StoreStep 8 6 nl2.s (.ok (storeEff nl2.s 8 6)) ∧
    nl1.s.P = nl2.s.P ∧ nl1.s.A[8]? = nl2.s.A[8]? ∧ nl1.s.A.length = nl2.s.A.length ∧
    nl1.s.A[7]? ≠ nl2.s.A[7]? ∧ nl1.s.F = nl2.s.F ∧
    ¬ NoLock (storeEff nl1.s 8 6) ∧ NoLock (storeEff nl2.s 8 6) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .ok (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Ern.MM03.LockOptions

instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a`, empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Appends an authority to `A`: its identity is `s.A.length`. -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (MM-03.3.6: a containing value
inherits the dependencies of the contained values). -/
def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Dependencies still valid for the values containing leaf `p` (MM-03.3 §5): every anchor of a
place of which `p` is a part is active. -/
def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- Non-escape restriction (MM-03.3.6) for anchor `x` and a destination of frame `fd`: if `x`
is a local anchor (no origin), its frame is `fd` or an ancestor of it, so `fd` does not outlive
it. The frame of an anchor is the frame of its holder (A4, A5). -/
def NoEscape (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.origin = none →
    OptP (s.hframe y.holder) (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) True) True) True

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (NoEscape s x fd) := by
  unfold NoEscape; infer_instance

/-- C1: the frame of the effective anchor of `x` exists and is `fd`, the frame of the dependent,
or one of its ancestors (MM-03.3.1, `ancestor`). The frame of an authority is the frame of its
holder (A4, A5). -/
def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance

/-- `AnchorOrder` extended to held authorities (G4): for every usable place `q` and every active
authority held by `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of that authority is the frame of `q` or
one of its ancestors (`EffAnchorOK`, C1). -/
def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A`: decidable form. -/
theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
  constructor
  · intro h q _ hq x _
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
    · trivial
  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` is owned by `src` or one of its parts, directly or through other owned places,
searched within `k` steps (A5). -/
def ownedWithinF (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => false
  | k + 1, q =>
    match s.P[q]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.owner with
      | .place o => decide (partOf s.P o src) || ownedWithinF s src k o
      | .frame _ => false
    | none => false

/-- Place `q` is owned, transitively, by the value at `src` (A5): its frame changes with the
value when `src` is transferred. -/
def OwnedWithin (s : S3) (src q : Nat) : Prop := ownedWithinF s src (s.P.length + 1) q = true

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4), in order: source usable (MM-03.3.1) and
1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source (F5:
the footprints of source and destination are disjoint, the clause `¬ overlap`, redundant with
clauses 1 and 2 by `transfer_overlap_redundant`),
and still usable once it owns the source's storage (no ownership cycle); exercisable `Modify`
on the source and on the destination (B2); 4 no active derived
access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame, for the anchors of the value and of the usable
places it owns, whose frame changes with it (A5), each frame read after the transfer (B7);
7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8); B8 on the effective anchor (C1): for every dependent
usable after the transfer, if its effective anchor moves with the value, or if the dependent
itself moves (the destination, or a place the value owns), the frame of the effective anchor is
the dependent's frame or an ancestor of it, both frames read after the transfer
(`EffAnchorOK`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state, the whole predicate, for every held
authority; J1: the destination has the shape of the source (`SameShape`). O4.3 holds by
construction. -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` other than the shape of the destination (J1): `TransferPre`
without its last clause (`transferPre_iff`). Used to show that a transfer is rejected by the shape
clause alone. -/
def TransferPreBase (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧

      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧

  unfold TransferPreBase; infer_instance

theorem transferPre_iff {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
    TransferPre k s src dst ↔ TransferPreBase k s src dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst := by
  unfold TransferPre TransferPreBase; simp only [and_assoc]

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
  unfold DependPre; infer_instance

/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## F4 `store` -/

/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
operation exists (F4). -/
def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
    True) ∧
  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance

/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/

/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
